# depiction interval

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:depictionInterval`](gmeow-depictionInterval.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/depictionInterval>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/images`](../../slices/images.md)

The time interval over which the depiction usage held. A relator carries its period this way (matching [`gmeow:usageInterval`](gmeow-usageInterval.md), [`gmeow:relationshipInterval`](gmeow-relationshipInterval.md)) rather than via RDF-star annotations on the relator node.
